annotations.title: Price a failed Music Video section retry

description: Creates or replays the live Music Video section-retry quote for a failed section. Identical retries reuse the original operationId. Optional orderId binds the request to the failed order. Returns the exact retry costEstimateId, credits and arguments for in-chat generation confirmation after customer approval. Confirmation retries use the returned operationId. Starts no video order. Films do not support section retry.

operationId.description: Stable identity for the same section retry request.

orderId.description: Optional failed order expected for this section.
